index.definition: CREATE INDEX listings_public_directory_order_idx ON zoi.listings USING btree (((rating IS NOT NULL)) DESC, rating DESC NULLS LAST, ((NULLIF((profile #>> '{brand,logo}'::text[]), ''::text) IS NOT NULL)) DESC, completeness_score DESC NULLS LAST, name) WHERE ((publish_status = 'published'::text) AND (moderation_status = ANY (ARRAY['clean'::text, 'cleared'::text])) AND (COALESCE(marketplace_status, ''::text) <> 'hidden'::text))
